title: The pup at the motel door
logline: The motel office's glass door from outside at 4 AM with the pup sitting against it on the mat, waiting, and inside the shape of a clerk not looking up. He comes to the shifts now. The page doesn't say since when.

panels.composition: A motel office's glass door at night from outside with a small three-legged dog sitting on the mat against it and inside, past the glass, the shape of a man at the desk not looking up, sodium light.
